content: <thought>Search for a structure similar to a five‑membered dioxole (C₅H₈O₂) that matches the observed 13C NMR (two sp² carbons ~136/117 ppm, one O‑CH at ~70 ppm, a methoxy‑like carbon at ~54 ppm, and an aliphatic carbon at ~44 ppm). The SMILES “C1OC=CO1” (1,3‑dioxole) fits the formula C₃H₄O₂, so I’ll search for related SMILES that include a methyl substituent, e.g., “CC1OC=CO1”.
